title: Delegation & Automation
hook: I did this exact task last week. And the week before. That's my sign to hand it off.
statement: If work repeats, offload it. Automate it or hand it to someone else.
explainer: Every hour on a task you've done a hundred times is an hour not spent on growth. Setup costs you once. Doing it by hand costs you forever.
sop: List every task you did this week exactly like last week.
Label each one: automate it with software, or delegate it to a person.
Subtract Automation Cost from Repetitive hours to get Time Freed.
Hand off the biggest Time Freed task first, not the easiest.
equation_example: Repetitive is 6 hours a week, Automation Cost is 1 hour. 6 - 1 = 5 hours a week freed. Higher means it's worth offloading now. Near zero or negative means the setup isn't worth it yet.
question: Name the most repetitive thing you're still doing by hand every week.
closing_statement: If it repeats, it shouldn't need you anymore.
caption:
